sn10.8:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati sītavane.
sn10.8:1.2: tena kho pana samayena anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati rājagahaṃ anuppatto hoti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
sn10.8:1.5: tāvadeva ca pana bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitukāmo hoti. atha kho anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa etadahosi
sn10.8:1.6: akālo kho ajja bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
sn10.8:1.7: svedānāhaṃ kālena bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissāmīti. buddhagatāya satiyā nipajji
sn10.8:1.8: rattiyā sudaṃ tikkhattuṃ vuṭṭhāsi pabhātanti maññamāno.
sn10.8:1.9: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena sīvathikadvāraṃ tenupasaṅkami.
sn10.8:1.11: atha kho anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nagaramhā nikkhamantassa āloko antaradhāyi andhakāro pāturahosi bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso udapādi. tato ca puna nivattitukāmo ahosi.
sn10.8:1.12: atha kho sivako yakkho antarahito saddaṃ anussāvesi
sn10.8:4.1: atha kho anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa andhakāro antaradhāyi āloko pāturahosi yaṃ ahosi bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso so paṭippassambhi.
sn10.8:4.2: dutiyampi kho anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa āloko antaradhāyi andhakāro pāturahosi bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso udapādi. tato ca puna nivattitukāmo ahosi.
sn10.8:4.3: dutiyampi kho sivako yakkho antarahito saddamanussāvesi
sn10.8:7.1: atha kho anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa andhakāro antaradhāyi āloko pāturahosi yaṃ ahosi bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso so paṭippassambhi.
sn10.8:7.2: tatiyampi kho anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa āloko antaradhāyi andhakāro pāturahosi bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso udapādi. tato ca puna nivattitukāmo ahosi.
sn10.8:7.3: tatiyampi kho sivako yakkho antarahito saddamanussāvesi
sn10.8:10.1: atha kho anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa andhakāro antaradhāyi āloko pāturahosi yaṃ ahosi bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso so paṭippassambhi.
sn10.8:10.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena sītavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
sn10.8:11.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya ajjhokāse caṅkamati.
sn10.8:11.2: addasā kho bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
sn10.8:11.3: disvāna caṅkamā orohitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn10.8:11.4: nisajja kho bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
sn10.8:11.6: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati nāmena maṃ bhagavā ālapatīti tattheva bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
